-----------

The order domain covers three distinct flows in the Zimmermann SFCC platform:

| Flow | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create Order | SFCC → MuleSoft → NewStore | Customer places order on SFCC; MuleSoft creates it in NewStore OMS |
| Order History & Details | SFCC → MuleSoft → NewStore | My Account — historic orders, returns, and order detail retrieval |
| Returns (Store → Narvar) | NewStore → MuleSoft → Narvar | Store return processed; linked to Narvar tracking |
| Returns (Narvar → 3PL) | Narvar → MuleSoft → 3PL SFTP | Customer-initiated return; MuleSoft routes to 3PL |

---

2. Flow: Create Order
---------------------

### 2.1 Trigger

A customer completes checkout on SFCC. SFCC calls MuleSoft with the **order ID** only — MuleSoft fetches the full order detail from SFCC.

### 2.2 System Flow

nonewide760Customer places order on SFCC
│
SFCC ──[orderId]──► orders-prc-api (Experience API)
│
Fetch full order from SFCC API
│
Transform to NewStore schema
(see mapping rules below)
│
POST ──► NewStore (create order)
│
Response ──► SFCC (order\_id + success/fail)

### 2.3 Key Data Mapping Rules

| Rule | Logic |
| --- | --- |
| Item quantity | SFCC qty > 1 split into individual line items (NewStore has no qty field) |
| 0-value orders (rewards) | Payment array → blank; shipping discount applied at item level |
| Price | From `extension_attributes.price` (SFCC recalculated field) |
| Tax (no rewards) | `item_tax_amount ÷ quantity` |
| Tax (with rewards) | `tax_pct × (price − discounts − rewards)` |
| Discount | `total_discount ÷ quantity` |
| Rewards split | `((item_price − item_discount) × total_rewards) ÷ (subtotal + order_discount)` |
| Rounding | Discrepancies adjusted on last item; final reconciliation on last product's price |
| Reward application order | Apply to items first, then to shipping |

### 2.4 SFCC Cartridge Touchpoint

* Custom controller/script in `int_custom_zim_global` calls MuleSoft `orders-prc-api` after order placement
* Passes `orderId` as query parameter
* Handles success/failure response and surfaces error to checkout if needed

---

3. Flow: Order History & Details (My Account)
---------------------------------------------

### 3.1 Trigger

Customer navigates to My Account in SFCC. SFCC calls MuleSoft to retrieve order data from NewStore.

### 3.2 System Flow

nonewide760SFCC (My Account)
│
├──[GET /orders?customer\_id&offset&count]──► sfcc-exp-api ──► NewStore
│ │
│ order summaries
│

│

return summaries

**Order summary fields returned to SFCC:**

| Field | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | NewStore order ID (e.g., ZX00000339) |
| `placed_at` | ISO timestamp |
| `status` | closed / open / cancelled |
| `currency` | Site currency (GBP / AUD / USD / EUR) |
| `fulfillment_type` | in\_store\_purchase / ship\_to\_address |

| `items[].external_identifier` | sku, ean13 |

-----------------

| HTTP Status | Scenario | SFCC Behaviour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Success | Render order data |
| 400 | Invalid request | Log + surface error message |
| 401 | Unauthorised | Re-authenticate + retry once |
| 404 | Order / customer not found | Show empty state in My Account |
| 500 | MuleSoft internal error | Show generic error; alert via Anypoint |
